app_info.subtitle: Create and organize flashcards
app_info.description: Turn material you choose in a conversation into flashcards saved in your Memo Card library. Find folders and decks, create cards with examples, improve existing cards, and organize them into decks and folders. Study your saved cards in the Memo Card web app or Telegram. Sign in through Telegram to grant the listed library access in one step. Moving cards preserves their review history. Permanent deletion happens only when explicitly requested. You can disconnect access in Memo Card settings. Requires an existing paid Memo Card plan, which includes MCP automation across supported clients. There is no additional charge for connecting ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves accessible folders and deck summaries without modifying library data
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on folders and decks already in the connected account's library
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or delete any library items

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves requested accessible decks and their card contents without modifying data
justifications.open_world_justification: Limits reads to decks associated with the connected account
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or delete cards or decks

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a folder with optional decks and cards, moves selected existing decks, and records changes
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only the connected account's editable Memo Card library
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite existing deck placement when existingDeckIds is supplied

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new deck with optional cards and records the changes
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates content only in the connected account's library and checks ownership of the destination folder
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds new content without overwriting or deleting existing content

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends cards to an owned deck and records the changes
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks deck ownership and writes only within Memo Card
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds new cards without overwriting or deleting existing cards

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates selected folder fields and records before and after values
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks folder ownership before changing Memo Card data
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the selected folder title or description

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates deck metadata or placement and records the changes
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks ownership of the deck and any destination folder
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites selected deck fields or existing folder placement

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates selected card fields and records before and after values
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks deck ownership and that every selected card belongs to that deck
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites selected card content and can clear examples

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes card placement and records the changes while retaining card identity and review history
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks ownership of both source and destination decks
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites card placement and ordering timestamp without deleting review history

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes selected cards from an owned deck and records their prior values
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks deck ownership and selected card membership before deletion
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes selected cards and associated scheduling and review history

test_cases.description: Read the reviewer sample deck without changing it
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the cards in my Demo · Spanish essentials deck
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the sample deck with Hello → Hola, Thank you → Gracias, and Water → Agua, including card IDs, front, back, and example fields

test_cases.description: Create a nested folder, deck, and cards; use a unique RUN suffix throughout the following cases
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a folder named Review Spanish RUN with a Travel deck containing Ticket → Billete and Train → Tren
test_cases.expected_output: Returns folder and createdDecks with one new folder, one nested deck, and two saved cards

test_cases.description: Create an unfiled deck and append a card
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an unfiled deck named Review Verbs RUN containing Eat → Comer, then add Drink → Beber
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the new deck and createdCards; the deck contains exactly Eat and Drink

test_cases.description: Edit and reorganize only the objects created in the preceding cases
test_cases.user_prompt: Rename Review Spanish RUN to Review Spanish Updated RUN, rename its Travel deck to Travel Updated, add example Necesito un billete to Ticket, and move Ticket into Review Verbs RUN
test_cases.tools_triggered: get_library, get_decks, update_folder, update_deck, update_cards, move_cards
test_cases.expected_output: Returns updated folder, deck, updatedCards, and movedCards; Ticket retains its ID and review history, Travel Updated contains Train, and Review Verbs RUN contains Eat, Drink, and Ticket

test_cases.description: Explicitly delete one card created during this review, leaving the sample fixture unchanged
test_cases.user_prompt: Permanently delete only the Train card from the Travel Updated deck created in this review
test_cases.expected_output: After any required confirmation, returns deletedCardIds containing only Train; Travel Updated is empty and Review Verbs RUN retains all three cards

negative_test_cases.description: Ambiguous deletion must not trigger a destructive action
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete the bad cards in Review Verbs RUN
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Ask which specific cards the user means and do not call delete_cards or change any cards

negative_test_cases.description: Studying and scheduling reviews are outside the exposed tool set
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Mark every card in my Memo Card deck as reviewed correctly today
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that review completion is handled in the Memo Card app and do not modify card content or simulate review history

negative_test_cases.description: External messaging is outside the exposed tool set
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send my Memo Card deck to my classmates on Telegram
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that this integration cannot send Telegram messages and do not invoke a library write tool
